input: Raw, label-independent source tokens; output tag indexes use the existing 11-tag order
featuresInOrder: s0 (class, digit count, optional final decimal-part length)
numericWords: Numeric strings and masks are replaced with <NUMBER>/<MASK> in all word features; digits canonicalized across ASCII, Arabic-Indic and Persian
shapes: mask; number plus digits capped at 8 and final decimal-part length capped at 4 when present; Arabic/Latin word; punctuation; mixed; BOS/EOS
numericInterpretation: Separator shapes are structural only; a final comma group is not assumed semantically decimal
weights: Contiguous featureIndex; row-major emissionWeights[feature*11+tag], transitionWeights[previous*11+tag]; bias is a learned feature
scoring: Float32 weights and zeroed scores; add each known feature in declared order, rounding after each addition; add transition last except at start
decoding: Greedy, smallest tag index wins ties; I-label allowed only after B-label or I-label of same type; no I-label at start
training: Averaged perceptron, 25 epochs, seed 20261024; no early stopping or validation-based feature search
scope: Already-valid synthetic development messages; isolated scorers, no active runtime integration or promotion
